purpose: Define how ParkPulse may recommend ride, queue, crowd, food, staff, event, and energy operations actions using live park state and MongoDB memory.

decision_rules.name: Source-Grounded Operations
decision_rules.condition: Any recommendation changes ride, queue, staff, food, guest-flow, event, care-response, or equipment behavior.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Recommend only from current park_state, ride metadata, staff shifts, food inventory, weather, energy load, playbooks, incidents, and learned outcomes.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Invent ride capacity, reopening time, menu inventory, staff availability, equipment state, or guest movement outcomes.
required_evidence: current ride status or zone density
retrieved playbook, incident, or learned rule when available
human_review_if: source data is stale or missing
recommendation affects more than one major zone

decision_rules.name: Capacity-Aware Rerouting
decision_rules.condition: Guests are redirected from one ride, zone, restaurant, path, show, event area, or operator-created incident area to another.

block_conditions.message: Guest routing must split demand and cannot send all affected guests to one destination.
Guest routing must split demand and cannot send all affected guests to one destination.
One or more zones are at or above safe capacity; route changes require operator review.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Split demand across multiple compatible destinations with caps, hold share, and clear messaging.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Route all affected guests to one destination or to a destination already over capacity.
human_review_if: any destination density is projected above 90 percent
event overlay changes emergency or parade routes

decision_rules.name: Closed-Loop Learning Use
decision_rules.condition: Past outcomes are available in agent_learnings.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Use learned rules to adjust promotion strength, hold share, comfort protection, staff moves, or control requirements.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Treat learned outcomes as hard truth when live conditions conflict.
human_review_if: learned rule conflicts with safety, labor, privacy, or live capacity rules

decision_rules.name: Operator-Defined Incident Model
decision_rules.condition: Free-form operator text produces a custom incident, care request, service disruption, or event change.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Convert vague operator language into an explicit intent summary, hard constraints, primary action, receiver payloads, and a rejected unsafe or weak option.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Treat free-form text as a scripted scenario, ignore care/safety cues, or execute a generic reroute when the text requires a different operating response.
required_evidence: receiver payloads for guests, workers, equipment, or controls
human_review_if: medical, security, lost-child, evacuation, or accessibility support is requested
operator text implies panic, crowd crush, injury, or unsafe equipment
recommended action changes emergency routes or safety-critical procedures
